faq.title: FAQ
faq.cardQ: Do I need to add a card to try 2EASY?
faq.cardA: No. The 7-day trial starts right after sign-up — no card needed.
faq.autoChargeQ: Will I be charged automatically after the trial?
faq.autoChargeA: No. Unless you subscribe yourself, free access simply ends after 7 days — there are no automatic charges.
faq.limitsQ: Are there limits on the number of students or lessons?
faq.limitsA: No, the number of students in a lesson is unlimited — invite everyone you teach.
faq.includedA: The builder for interactive lessons and courses, 200+ lesson plans and all 2easy courses, speaking games, 150+ discussion cards, the «grammar» section and new materials every week.
faq.helpQ: What if I don’t understand how a feature works?
faq.helpA: Message us in the support chat on the site or on Telegram — we’ll help you figure it out.
